evidence.excerpt: MLB press release, 19 Mar 2026 (also CNBC, Fortune, Front Office Sports the same day): Major League Baseball named Polymarket its exclusive Official Prediction Market Exchange in a multi-year agreement. Polymarket and its brokers receive exclusive access to MLB marks and logos inside their products, Official League Data through Sportradar, and brand exposure across MLB's digital ecosystem and at league events; the parties agreed an integrity framework restricting markets such as individual pitches, and Commissioner Manfred signed a memorandum of understanding with CFTC Chairman Selig. Front Office Sports reports the deal at up to $300 million (REPORTED; MLB did not disclose terms).

Bloomberg, 31 Aug 2026 (carried by Yahoo Finance, Investing.com and CryptoRank the same day): 1789 Capital is leading a $1 billion funding round for Polymarket at a $21 billion post-money valuation, contributing about $300 million and taking its combined stake to roughly $500 million once the round closes; the valuation is 40% above the $15 billion price of the April round. 1789 Capital was co-founded by Donald Trump Jr.

Bloomberg, 20 Apr 2026, and Finance Magnates / Qz, 4-6 Aug 2026: Polymarket closed a round at a $15 billion valuation in April 2026 that brought in D.E. Shaw and G Squared as new investors, with SV Angel, Dragonfly and Valor Equity Partners adding capital; the total was about $1 billion including Intercontinental Exchange's $600 million commitment. The round was not publicly disclosed until August (REPORTED).

Intercontinental Exchange press release, 7 Oct 2025 (also Fortune, Forbes): ICE, parent of the New York Stock Exchange, will invest up to $2 billion in Polymarket at a valuation of approximately $8 billion pre-investment, and becomes a global distributor of Polymarket's event-driven data as sentiment indicators; the two agreed to partner on future tokenisation initiatives. Polymarket confirmed a $9 billion post-money valuation (REPORTED).

CoinDesk, Qz and CP24, 10 Sep 2026: Polymarket named Warren Jenson its first Chief Financial Officer. Jenson, 69, was finance chief at Amazon, Electronic Arts, Delta Air Lines and Nielsen and sits on the boards of Dropbox and Ripple; he reports to CEO Shayne Coplan and will lead the finance organisation, set financial and capital strategy and build infrastructure for the next phase of growth.

CNBC, 11 Aug 2026, and The Block, 12 Aug 2026: Polymarket is restructuring its marketing operation and adding senior executives ahead of an expected surge in trading around the NFL season in September and the November midterm elections. Travis VanderZanden, founder of Bird and formerly head of driver growth at Uber and CRO at Yammer, joined as Chief Growth Officer and also oversees the marketing function (announced by CEO Shayne Coplan on 12 Aug). Compliance hires: Megan McGrath (ex-Robinhood) as chief compliance officer of the US exchange, Natalie Oblazny (ex-Coinbase) regulatory affairs, Shana Bautista (ex-FBI, Coinbase) global head of investigations, Paul Jordan (ex-Nasdaq) chief risk officer for Polymarket US. The marketing restructuring followed scrutiny of promotional practices in which creators recorded simulated trades on counterfeit versions of the site aimed at US audiences.

SBC Americas, 20 Feb 2026; Gambling Insider; NEXT.io; Crunchbase profile: Ari Borod joined Polymarket as President of Sports Business Development, based in New York, after four years as Chief Business Officer of Fanatics (Aug 2022 to Jan 2026); earlier roles at The Action Network, FanDuel Group and the law firm Gibson Dunn. Fanatics sued to enforce a non-compete and the parties settled. Front Office Sports (Yankees deal) describes him as leading Polymarket's major sports partnerships.

Shayne Coplan is Polymarket's founder and Chief Executive Officer (his own announcement of the Jenson appointment, Sep 2026; CoinDesk 10 Sep 2026; House Oversight Committee letter addressed to him as Chief Executive Officer, 22 May 2026).

NHL.com, 23 Oct 2025 (also ESPN, Yahoo Sports): the NHL announced multi-year US marketing agreements making Kalshi and Polymarket its official prediction market partners, the first such deals by a major US league; both receive official NHL data, rights to NHL marks and logos, and brand exposure via digitally enhanced dasherboards and virtual signage on broadcasts.

PR Newswire (also Sportcal, Gaming Intelligence, Front Office Sports), 2026 season: Polymarket became an Official Prediction Market Partner of the New York Yankees for the remainder of the 2026 MLB season, with LED signage throughout Yankee Stadium and rotating home-plate signage on YES Network and Prime Video broadcasts. Coverage lists Polymarket's recent league deals with MLS, Serie A, LaLiga, Bundesliga and Liga MX.

SBC Americas, 8 Jan 2026: the New York Rangers named Polymarket the team's official prediction market partner, Polymarket's first major professional team partnership, following the league-wide NHL agreement.
usopen.org, 31 Aug 2026: Kalshi was named the Official Prediction Market Partner of the US Open (USTA) — a rightsholder selling the prediction-market category as its own designation.

Formula One World Championship Limited, 5 Mar 2026, and SportsPro / Insider Sport, 5-6 Mar 2026: Formula 1 named Betway its first Official Betting Operator in a multi-year deal covering Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Canada and Mexico. The structure is non-exclusive and regional — F1 said it would sign further regional partners, the US first — and it is the first series-level betting relationship; such deals had previously been left to teams and promoters. No prediction-market partner has been announced by Formula 1 (search of corp.formula1.com and the F1 partners page, 15 Sep 2026).

Formula One World Championship Limited and PR Newswire, 30 Apr 2026: FanDuel was named an Official Betting Operator of Formula 1 in a multi-year deal, F1's first with a betting operator in the United States (US and Canada), announced ahead of the Miami Grand Prix; FanDuel odds are integrated into F1's Betting Guide and editorial content. Named as 'an' Official Betting Operator, not the exclusive one.

Sponsor table (seeds/sponsors.json, 2026 rows, active/joined unless stated): Atlassian Williams Racing — Betway, Jackpot City Casino, Kraken; BWT Alpine — Modo Casino; McLaren — OKX, Allwyn, FxPro, Gemini, Hedera; Aston Martin Aramco — Coinbase, Public, Pepperstone, Circle, CoinPayments; Oracle Red Bull Racing — Gate.io, Ava Trade; Mercedes-AMG Petronas — Nasdaq, Nu, UBS; Scuderia Ferrari — BingX, Vantage (VGW Play departed); Audi — Revolut (title), Libertex, NEXO (Stake departed within 12 months); MoneyGram Haas (TGR Haas) — MGM Rewards, Zoomex, FIX Network; Visa Cash App Racing Bulls — Visa and Cash App (title), XM Trading. Cadillac F1 Team — no betting, casino, exchange or trading partner.

Cadillac F1 Team partners page (search summary, 14-15 Sep 2026) and the sponsor table: TWG AI (primary and exclusive AI partner, 4 Feb 2026), Core Scientific (data centre, 10 Mar 2026), IFS (technology), Claro / América Móvil, Jim Beam (spirits, 17 Sep 2025), Tenneco (technical), Tommy Hilfiger (apparel), plus Pirelli and Alpinestars. No betting, casino, exchange, trading or prediction-market partner.

Forbes, 17 Nov 2025; Sportcal; BlackBook Motorsport, Nov-Dec 2025: Cadillac F1 appointed Lauren Teixeira Chief Commercial Officer (previously Head of Business Operations at F1 Academy and Director of Paddock Club & Industry Relations at the Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix) and Willem Dinger Chief Partnerships Officer (ten years at Unilever, latterly head of sports partnerships), both reporting to Tyler Epp, Global Head of Commercial Strategy and former president of the Miami Grand Prix. Dinger: the team is building a 'fewer, bigger, better partnership ecosystem'. Teixeira, Dec 2025: 'we're not looking for a title partner'.

RTR Sports (agency analysis, 2026): Cadillac's partner tiers are reported as two or three primary partners at $40-50 million a year, three to five premium partners at $20-30 million, and technical supplier roles from $500,000 (REPORTED, not a Cadillac rate card). 1440's $15-25M a year is an ESTIMATE placed at and below the reported premium tier for a first-year category entry.

Yahoo Sports (ownership explainer), ESPN and The Race (Aug 2026), Qz (26 Aug 2026), Motorsport.com (21 Aug 2026): TWG Motorsports, a subsidiary of TWG Global, holds the controlling stake in the Cadillac F1 team, with General Motors a partner and shareholder. TWG Global was founded in 2024 by Mark Walter, its CEO and co-chairman (Thomas Tull co-chairman); TWG Global holds controlling interests in the Los Angeles Dodgers, Chelsea, the Los Angeles Lakers, the Los Angeles Sparks and the PWHL. Walter is under a US Department of Justice and SEC investigation into alleged fraud involving funds at his insurance companies (Guggenheim Partners, Delaware Life and Clear Spring received grand-jury subpoenas in February; reports describe undisclosed 'self-loans' of $16-20 billion). TWG Global denies fraud ('there has been no fraud') and TWG Motorsports stated before the Dutch Grand Prix that it is not considering a sale of the Cadillac team.

SBC Americas, 20 Jan 2026; Yogonet, 3 Feb 2026; Flushdraw and Front Office Sports, May-Jun 2026: the Nevada Gaming Control Board brought a civil enforcement action arguing Polymarket's sports markets are unlicensed sports wagering; on Friday 29 May 2026 Judge Jason Woodbury of the First Judicial District Court granted a preliminary injunction against QCX LLC doing business as Polymarket US, and Polymarket geo-blocked Nevada residents. Cease-and-desist orders were issued in January 2026 by Tennessee's Sports Wagering Council, the Arizona Department of Gaming, Illinois and Connecticut.

CNBC and the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, 22 May 2026 (WSJ, CoinDesk, The Hill): Chairman James Comer opened an investigation into insider trading on Polymarket and Kalshi, writing to CEO Shayne Coplan for documents on identity verification of domestic and foreign account holders, geographic restrictions and monitoring of suspicious trading, after a New York Times investigation found more than 80 Polymarket users placed suspiciously timed bets, including hours before undisclosed US and Israeli military operations against Iran. Response deadline 5 June 2026.

PR Newswire, Jul 2025, and Yahoo Finance, Nov 2025: Polymarket acquired the CFTC-licensed exchange and clearinghouse QCEX for $112 million (Jul 2025), now QCX LLC, a Designated Contract Market; on 25 Nov 2025 the CFTC issued an Amended Order of Designation recognising Polymarket as an intermediated trading platform under QCX, enabling the US relaunch. Polymarket had been barred from serving US users under a 2022 CFTC settlement.

The Block data dashboard; BitKE, Apr 2026; KuCoin, Mar 2026: Polymarket recorded $10.57 billion of trading volume in March 2026, the first month above $10 billion and about 2.5 times the October 2024 election peak; February 2026 exceeded $7 billion with a single-day record of $425 million on 28 Feb 2026 (above the $371 million set during the 2024 US election). October 2025: $3.02 billion with about 478,000 active traders.

Polymarket Help Center (Trading Fees) and KuCoin / Phemex coverage: Polymarket charged no trading fees until 2026; Fee Structure V2 took effect on 30 Mar 2026 with taker fees by category (sports 0.03, later 0.05; crypto 0.07; politics and finance 0.04) and maker rebates funded from them; the US exchange schedule (3 Apr 2026) applies a uniform 0.05 taker fee. Coverage reported a target of about $1 million a day in fee revenue. Revenue is not disclosed.

polymarket.com/sports/formula1 and /sports/f1/props (search summaries, Sep 2026; Deadspin and Betting.net guides): Polymarket runs a dedicated Formula 1 section with markets on race winner, pole position, fastest lap, championship standings and props including safety cars and red flags. Neither Polymarket nor Kalshi holds an official Formula 1 or F1-team designation.

2026 F1 calendar (seeds/calendar_2026.json, spec §1.3): round 19 US GP (Austin), round 20 Mexico City GP, round 21 São Paulo GP, round 22 Las Vegas GP, round 23 Qatar GP, round 24 Abu Dhabi GP close the season in October-December; the Miami GP is the season's first North American round in May. Teams close the following year's partner rosters in the fourth quarter.
Yahoo Finance, 1 Sep 2026: 'Polymarket valuation hits $21bn as Trump Jr's firm leads $1bn round' — 1789 Capital, the venture firm co-founded by Donald Trump Jr., leads the round.

KuCoin, Mar 2026: Polymarket's previous daily volume high of $371 million was set during the 2024 US election; the February 2026 record of $425 million surpassed it. US elections are the platform's historic peak-volume events.

brief.industry_meta: Prediction Markets · Sports Rights & Crypto-Native Trading
brief.deck: Polymarket, the prediction market that turns news and sport into tradeable odds, has a $1B round at a $21B valuation led by 1789 Capital, reported by Bloomberg on 31 August and 40% above April's $15B price, and named its first CFO ten days later.
brief.the_case_p1: Intercontinental Exchange committed up to $2B in October 2025, making the owner of the New York Stock Exchange the distributor of Polymarket's event data; an April raise at $15B then brought in DE Shaw and G Squared (reported). Volume crossed $10B in a month for the first time in March 2026, and trading fees arrived on 30 March. Ari Borod, Fanatics' former chief business officer, joined in February as President of Sports Business Development; Warren Jenson, once Amazon's finance chief, became the first CFO on 10 September.
brief.the_case_p2: Rightsholders now sell this category on its own. MLB made Polymarket its exclusive prediction-market exchange in March, a deal reported at up to $300M; the NHL took both Polymarket and Kalshi; the Yankees and Rangers signed at club level; Kalshi became the US Open's prediction-market partner on 31 August. Formula 1 sold betting-operator rights to Betway and FanDuel this year and left prediction markets unsold.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The money landed on 31 August and the first CFO on 10 September; the NFL season and the November midterms are the volume events the marketing rebuild was hired for. Teams close 2027 rosters in the fourth quarter, and the United States GP in Austin in late October is the announcement stage.
brief.why_team_para: Cadillac F1 Team is the one roster with no betting, casino, exchange or trading brand: Williams carries Betway and Jackpot City, Alpine Modo Casino, McLaren OKX and Allwyn, Aston Martin Coinbase and Public. Its owner group, TWG Global, also controls the Los Angeles Dodgers, whose league made Polymarket its exclusive exchange. American, debut season, and a stated preference for fewer, bigger partners.
brief.value_content: MODE B, halo with mechanics. Polymarket's Formula 1 markets (race winner, pole, fastest lap, safety car) become a free-to-play Cadillac predictions game in the team app and market-implied win probabilities in race-week content. Commercially: a $21B partner at the reported premium tier, a young US audience, Austin and Miami hospitality. Nothing reaches the car.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Prediction Market Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, running through the 2028 US election, historically its peak-volume event. Estimated $15-25M a year against a reported premium tier of $20-30M. Scope: livery and garage placement, the predictions game, Austin and Miami hospitality. Las Vegas excluded until Nevada lifts its injunction.
brief.decision_maker_role: President of Sports Business Development, Polymarket
brief.decision_maker_bio: Borod runs Polymarket's sports partnerships, joining in February 2026 from Fanatics, where he was chief business officer. Path: Travis VanderZanden, Chief Growth Officer (marketing); Warren Jenson, Chief Financial Officer; Shayne Coplan, founder and Chief Executive Officer.
brief.opening_angle_intro: Lead with the category, not the car.
brief.opening_angle_quote: “Ari, you took MLB and the Yankees this season. Formula 1 sold its betting rights and left prediction markets unsold; one clean American roster is being built for 2027. 25 minutes before Austin?”
score_cells: Round 31 Aug; first CFO 10 Sep; Austin inside the window.
$1B raised at $21B; ICE up to $2B; fees only since March.
Young US live-sport audience; gambling-adjacent, political, Nevada out.
NFL and midterm volume, US build-out, Kalshi taking rightsholders.
MODE B: fan-engagement halo; nothing for the car.
risks: TWG Global's Mark Walter is under a DOJ and SEC investigation he denies; 1789 Capital, co-founded by Donald Trump Jr., leads the round while a House Oversight insider-trading probe is open.
Put both on the table in the first call and contract reputational exit rights both ways.
Polymarket US is enjoined in Nevada with cease-and-desists in four more states, and F1 holds Betway and FanDuel as Official Betting Operators: is a prediction market a separable category?
F1's betting deals are regional and non-exclusive; MLB and the NHL run both categories side by side. Clear the definition with Cadillac's counsel first.
brief.bottom_line: $1B at $21B, a first CFO, a sports-rights buyer that took MLB, the NHL and the Yankees inside a year, and a grid that sold betting twice and prediction markets never, with one clean American roster. Politics, regulators and a halo-only workstream hold it at 71; brand fit is under the engine's 12-point gate, so the desk ranks it 62. Built on request.

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: On 31 August 2026 Bloomberg reported a $1B funding round for Polymarket at a $21B post-money valuation, led by 1789 Capital, which is contributing about $300M and will hold a combined stake of roughly $500M. The valuation is 40% above April's $15B price. 1789 Capital was co-founded by Donald Trump Jr.

why_now.label: The round before, and the exchange that owns the NYSE
why_now.text: The April 2026 raise at $15B, undisclosed until August, brought in DE Shaw and G Squared with SV Angel, Dragonfly and Valor adding capital (reported). Before that, in October 2025, Intercontinental Exchange committed up to $2B at about $8B pre-money and became the global distributor of Polymarket's event-driven data. Three price marks in eleven months: $9B, $15B, $21B.

why_now.label: A commercial organisation built in seven months
why_now.text: Ari Borod arrived in February 2026 from Fanatics, where he was chief business officer, as President of Sports Business Development. Travis VanderZanden, founder of Bird, joined on 12 August as Chief Growth Officer with the marketing function under him, alongside compliance and risk hires from Robinhood, Coinbase and Nasdaq. Warren Jenson became the first Chief Financial Officer on 10 September. That is the shape of a company preparing to be measured.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: The NFL season and the November midterms are the volume events the August marketing rebuild was hired for. In Formula 1 the season closes through the United States GP in Austin in late October, Mexico City, São Paulo, Las Vegas in November, Qatar and Abu Dhabi, and teams close 2027 partner rosters in the fourth quarter. Austin is the announcement stage; Las Vegas is not, because Polymarket US is enjoined in Nevada.

why_team.label: The only clean roster
why_team.text: Every other team carries a brand that conflicts with or crowds this category. Williams carries Betway and Jackpot City Casino, Alpine Modo Casino, McLaren OKX and Allwyn, Aston Martin Coinbase and Public, Red Bull Gate.io and Ava Trade, Mercedes Nasdaq, Ferrari BingX, Audi Revolut and Libertex with Stake departed within the year, Haas MGM Rewards and Zoomex, Racing Bulls XM Trading. Cadillac's debut roster is TWG AI, Core Scientific, IFS, Claro, Jim Beam, Tenneco and Tommy Hilfiger, and none of them sits anywhere near betting, casino, exchange or trading.

why_team.label: The owner group, stated with the caveat
why_team.text: TWG Motorsports, a subsidiary of TWG Global, holds the controlling stake in the team with General Motors as partner. TWG Global also controls the Los Angeles Dodgers, a club in the league that made Polymarket its exclusive prediction-market exchange in March, so the category is already understood inside the owner group. The caveat is on page two as risk one: TWG Global's founder Mark Walter is under a Department of Justice and SEC investigation into alleged fraud at his insurance companies, which TWG denies, and the group has said the team is not for sale.

why_team.label: A commercial team built to sell this
why_team.text: Cadillac hired Lauren Teixeira as Chief Commercial Officer and Willem Dinger as Chief Partnerships Officer in November 2025, reporting to Tyler Epp, the former president of the Miami Grand Prix. Dinger has described the target as a fewer, bigger, better partnership ecosystem, and Teixeira has said the team is not looking for a title partner. The partner tiers reported for Cadillac are $40-50M a year for a primary partner and $20-30M for a premium one: a $21B company with $1B of new capital can pay the premium tier without it being the largest cheque it wrote this year.

why_team.label: Where it activates
why_team.text: Austin in late October and Miami in May are the two US rounds where Polymarket US can operate and host; Las Vegas is excluded while the Nevada injunction stands. An American debut team with a young, mobile-first audience is the right stage for a product whose fans already trade race-winner, pole and safety-car markets on the platform.

value.label: Fan-engagement layer (Mode B)
value.text: Polymarket's Formula 1 markets — race winner, pole position, fastest lap, championship standings, safety cars and red flags — become a free-to-play Cadillac predictions game inside the team app and website, with market-implied win probabilities in race-week content and live odds in team-channel graphics. This is a halo with working mechanics; it does not touch the car, and the brief says so.

value.label: Commercial lift for the team
value.text: A $21B partner at the reported premium tier in year one of the team's commercial build, plus a partner whose business is live events and whose audience is young, American and mobile-first — the demographic Cadillac's other B2C partners, Jim Beam and Tommy Hilfiger, are buying.

value.label: Content and data
value.text: A live-odds content series across the season, Polymarket's event-probability data (distributed globally by Intercontinental Exchange) as a storytelling device for strategy calls and championship swings, and driver and engineer appearances in Polymarket's own channels.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Prediction Market Partner designation, livery and garage placement, naming of the Cadillac predictions game, Austin and Miami hospitality, and driver and engineering access for Polymarket's content and its sports-rights partners.

ruled_out.reason: Betway and Jackpot City Casino hold the betting and gaming lane; Kraken holds crypto exchange.
Modo Casino holds the gaming lane.
Allwyn is a lottery operator and OKX a crypto exchange; Gemini and Hedera crowd the lane further.
Public is a retail trading app; Coinbase, Circle and Pepperstone crowd the lane.
Gate.io is a crypto exchange and Ava Trade a broker; the trading lane is occupied.
Nasdaq sits on the roster, and Polymarket's largest strategic investor is Nasdaq's rival, Intercontinental Exchange.
BingX is a crypto exchange and Vantage a broker; VGW Play, a social casino, departed within the year.
Stake departed within the last 12 months and Libertex and NEXO remain; Revolut holds title.
MGM Rewards is a casino loyalty brand and Zoomex a crypto exchange.

Open on betting but not chosen: XM Trading crowds the trading lane, and Visa's rules on event-contract merchants would need clearing first. The runner-up if Cadillac's ownership question makes a board hesitate.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Ari Borod before the United States GP to establish whether a prediction market is a separable category under Formula 1's Betway and FanDuel agreements, to put the Walter investigation and the House Oversight probe on the table in both directions, and to size an Official Prediction Market Partner entry at Cadillac for 2027-2029, Las Vegas excluded until Nevada is resolved.

## Decision path

Ari Borod (President of Sports Business Development) is the buyer: he has run every sports deal since February. Path: Travis VanderZanden (Chief Growth Officer, marketing reports to him), Warren Jenson (Chief Financial Officer, first, 10 Sep), Shayne Coplan (founder and Chief Executive Officer). No chief marketing officer is named; marketing sits under the CGO.

## Leadership ties

Coplan, VanderZanden, Jenson, Borod: **none found** after checking. Borod's earlier employment at FanDuel Group — now an F1 Official Betting Operator — is an ecosystem familiarity, not a motorsport deal tie, and is not claimed as one.

## Team choice and the concentration point

Cadillac is the fourteenth F1 case pointed at the team. It is chosen on grid occupancy, not habit: it is the only roster without a betting, casino, exchange or trading brand. Visa Cash App Racing Bulls is the named runner-up (XM Trading crowds the trading lane; Visa's merchant rules on event contracts would need clearing). The Walter investigation is risk one, not a footnote, and the TWG–Dodgers–MLB link is stated with that caveat attached.
